{{Top|leg}}
The Imperial '''Acolyte Program''' was a government program set up to recruit special [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] to be [[Imperial Sith Acolyte|Sith Acolytes]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They would act as a special security force against other force users. The [[Saber Program]], which produced the [[Saber Guard]]s, apparently had some ties to the Acolyte Program.
